summary: Grayscale CoinDesk Crypto 5 ETF filed an 8-K reporting that its manager, Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, entered a Sixth Amendment to the Master Custody Service Agreement on September 29, 2026, adding Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., an OCC-chartered national trust bank, as an additional custodian for a portion of the fund's components. Coinbase Custody remains primary custodian; allocation amounts and timing are undetermined and discretionary. No deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no shareholder action are involved. This is a routine custody-services contract disclosure, not a special situation; watch for allocation details in future filings.
